principles: Split at session/task/scenario level where the source provides such identifiers.
Keep all messages from one session in exactly one split.
Do not split individual hops from the same attack session across train, validation, and test.
Do not place near-duplicate or source-variant records across training and evaluation splits.
Preserve source provenance in every sample.
Do not duplicate samples to balance splits.
Samples that cannot be assigned safely remain unassigned until reviewed.
important_constraint: Ratios are targets, not permission to violate source-level or scenario-level leakage constraints.
